verdicts.explanation: Both affected pages carry a JSON-LD block that fails to parse (malformed_blocks: 1) alongside valid breadcrumb/webpage blocks, so the malformed block is discarded and contributes nothing, exactly as the finding states.
The homepage carries no JSON-LD at all (jsonld.types is empty), so there is no Organization/LocalBusiness block and no sameAs link for an assistant to anchor the brand to.

fixes.quote: Your dream smile shouldn’t break the bank.
site_specific: Run the JSON-LD on /mottoaligners/pricing and /mottoaligners/results through a validator (e.g. Google's Rich Results Test) to find the malformed block alongside the working BreadcrumbList/WebPage blocks.
Fix the syntax error (commonly a stray comma or unescaped quote from the templated price/offer text) rather than removing the block.
Add a Product or Service block with a priceSpecification for the $2,999 Motto price so the fixed markup actually states the fact, not just parses.

fixes.quote: Aspen Dental | Find a Dentist Near You for Dental Care
site_specific: Add an Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD block to the homepage with name 'Aspen Dental'.
Include a sameAs array linking to Aspen Dental's Wikipedia, LinkedIn, Facebook and X/Twitter profiles.
Reuse the same block (or a per-location LocalBusiness variant) on /about, since that page also carries no structured data.

fixes.quote: How do Motto clear aligners work to straighten teeth?
site_specific: Wrap 'How do Motto clear aligners work to straighten teeth?' and its answer paragraph in FAQPage/Question/Answer JSON-LD.
Keep each answer self-contained (one paragraph that does not depend on the surrounding page) so it can be lifted as a unit.
Repeat the pattern for the other FAQ headings on this page and the six other Motto pages the finding lists.
